FLASHCARD SET · AGES 3–4 YEARS

Alphabet Tracing Cards A–Z

Twenty-six dotted tracing cards, one for every letter. Numbered arrows show the strokes: start at 1, follow the arrow, lift at the dot. Trace with a finger first — then a crayon, right on the card.

THE CARDS

All twenty-six, ready to download.

Tap any card to open its own page with the words to say together — or tap Download to keep the card itself. Every card below has its own download button — the full-size tracing card, straight from this page.

HOW TO USE THESE CARDS

Little ways that work.

  1. 01

    Start small

    Pick three cards and lay them face up. Three cards is a lovely little class — the whole alphabet can wait.

  2. 02

    Follow the arrows

    Start at the number 1 dot and follow the arrow to the end of the stroke, saying the movement out loud. Then hand the crayon over.

  3. 03

    Tape one up

    Put today’s card at eye level — the fridge, a door. Passing it again and again is quietly powerful practice.

  4. 04

    Match the sets

    Lay a card from this set beside the same card from another letter set and let your child find the pair. The same apple keeps showing up, wearing different clothes.
